messages.content: Assign only relative duration weights. Do not allocate integer beats. Return valid JSON only.

FIXED CHAPTERS:
Chapter 1 contains setup plus the main repeated process explicitly described as the MAJORITY of the story.
Chapter 2 contains only final resolution plus immediate closure.

Assign each chapter a relative duration weight using small positive integers from 1 to 5.
The weights should reflect expected screen time from source emphasis.

Return JSON with key weights, an array of two integers in chapter order.
